paragraphs: Alice Morgan - Senior Backend Engineer. Eight years building high-throughput payment services in Go and Python. Focus on reliability, observability and mentoring junior engineers.

Northwind Payments (2020-2024), Staff Engineer. Designed an event-driven settlement pipeline on Kafka processing 40 million transactions a day. Cut p99 latency from 900ms to 120ms by introducing idempotent consumers and partitioned retries.

Lumen Logistics (2016-2020), Backend Developer. Built REST APIs in Python with FastAPI and PostgreSQL for fleet tracking. Migrated a monolith to Docker containers on AWS ECS and wrote the on-call runbooks.
Education: BSc Computer Science, University of Leeds, 2016. Certifications: AWS Solutions Architect Associate, Certified Kubernetes Application Developer.
Skills: Go, Python, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Redis, Terraform, Prometheus, Grafana, gRPC, distributed tracing.
Bob Chen - Data Scientist. Six years applying machine learning to healthcare and retail problems. Comfortable moving from research prototype to production model serving.

Helio Health (2021-2024), Senior Data Scientist. Trained PyTorch transformer models for clinical note classification, reaching 0.91 F1 on discharge summaries. Deployed the model behind a batch inference service and monitored drift weekly.

Orbit Retail (2018-2021), Data Scientist. Built demand forecasting models with gradient boosting that reduced stockouts by 18 percent across 300 stores. Presented weekly forecasts to merchandising leadership.
Education: PhD Statistics, University of Edinburgh, 2018, thesis on Bayesian time series. Publications: two papers on hierarchical forecasting at NeurIPS workshops.
Skills: Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, SQL, Spark, MLflow, Bayesian modelling, experiment design.
Senior Backend Engineer at Brightpath Fintech. You will own the ledger service that records every customer payment and keep it correct under heavy load.

Requirements: five or more years of backend development in Go or Java, strong knowledge of relational databases, experience with message queues such as Kafka or RabbitMQ, and a habit of writing automated tests.
Benefits: 25 days paid holiday, hybrid working from our Manchester office two days a week, annual learning budget of 1500 pounds, private health insurance.
Machine Learning Engineer at Quanta Medical. You will build and ship models that triage radiology reports and help clinicians prioritise urgent cases.

Requirements: three or more years with PyTorch, experience deploying models on Kubernetes, familiarity with MLflow or similar experiment tracking, and clear written communication with non-technical stakeholders.
Benefits: fully remote within the UK, equity options, 30 days holiday, conference travel budget, and a home office stipend.
Company: Acme Robotics. Overview: warehouse automation startup founded in 2017 with 400 employees, headquartered in Boston. Customers include large grocery chains.
Culture: engineers are expected to visit customer sites quarterly. Interviews include a pair-programming round and a system design discussion. Glassdoor sentiment is positive about work-life balance.
Tech Stack: C++, ROS2, Python, Kubernetes, Postgres. Recent News: raised a 60 million Series C in March and opened a new fulfilment testing lab in Ohio.
Company: Globex Energy. Overview: renewable energy utility founded in 1998 with 12000 employees, headquartered in Houston. Operates wind farms across Texas and Oklahoma.
Culture: formal hierarchy and a strong safety-first mindset. Hiring involves three panel interviews and a written case study. Glassdoor sentiment is mixed about promotion speed.
Tech Stack: Java, Oracle, SAP, Azure. Recent News: announced a 2 billion dollar offshore wind investment and a hiring freeze in the trading division.
Carol Diaz - Frontend Engineer. Five years building accessible React and TypeScript interfaces for e-commerce platforms.
